habitatClass.description: Show wiring (LIVING-WORLD P2 binding). Fill only from a canon source or a method that proves the class (surf/fish -> water); otherwise null = owed.

status.description: Per-slot provenance: 'canon: encounters.json seed' / 'canon-prose, numbers owed' / 'provisional'.

timeOfDay.description: Null = canon has not split this slot by time; applies across bands until a canon source splits it.

weather.description: Null in all canon seeds to date; vocabulary set by the first canon source that populates it.

weight.description: Relative weight within the table (canon seed scale); normalised at roll time. Null only when canon names the species for the area in prose without numbers.

rodTier.description: #111 angling: null = answers any rod (all pre-#111 rows). A tier key restricts the slot to that rod tier or better.

method.description: Canon method vocabulary from encounters.json. Forest floor rolls on 'grass'. 'dive' added by List 20 #192 (water traversal & dive) at its landing — a method value only; no dive table exists.

horde.description: #158 horde eligibility slot (proposed by List 17 #158, landed here citing it): null (the universal current state — no instance carries the field) means the area never hordes; an object {size} enables roll-time horde composition over the area's own rows. No table gains a non-null value in this landing; no horde can roll anywhere.

ambush.description: #209 ambush eligibility slot (proposed by List 22 #209, landed here citing it, on the #158 horde precedent): null/absent = the table never ambushes. No table gains the slot's contents in this landing.

encounterRate.description: #255 (List 26) encounter-rate seat, landed here citing it: probability that a step taken in this table's terrain starts an encounter, rolled per step on #94's seeded draw. null = not yet authored — the engine reads the method class default stated in #255 (grass 0.10, cave 0.10, surf 0.05 per step; fish has no per-step roll — #111's cast owns fishing encounters).

description: Native schema extending the canon seed shape of src/data/core/encounters.json ({mapId, method, minLevel, maxLevel, weight}, timeOfDay/weather present-but-null). Field naming follows the core data convention (camelCase). Unknowns are null and flagged in status, never invented (core README convention). A spawn FILE is either one area object (this schema) or a bundle: {bundle: <slug>, bundleNote?: string, areas: [<area objects>]} — the Garden complex and the tiered Dark Forest ship as bundles.

areaId.description: Canon map/area id, e.g. pond-route-01, dark-forest.

depthTier.description: Dark Forest only; null everywhere else. One file per tier for the Forest.

showLocation.description: Show-side location this area plays as (LIVING-WORLD), e.g. 'the Pond'. Null if the area has no show counterpart yet.

status.description: File-level provenance in the core convention, e.g. 'canon seed rows, re-homed verbatim' / 'OPEN — canon does not stock this tier'.

encounterMode.description: Encounter mode (#110 + #170 combined patch, completed at the List 18 landing citing both packages): absent = standard. sanctuary = #110's sanctuary law (110-SANCTUARY-ZONE.md); safari = #170's safari-zone law (170-SAFARI-ZONES.md). Forest-exclusion validation: the Dark Forest depths may never carry a non-standard mode (its tables stay empty by law). No area gains the field in this landing.
